note: AeroTech's single-use DMS motors have published nozzle drawings after all, in the same format as the reload-kit ones, and they had been sitting unread. 33 more in-production motors now fill in their own exit diameter, taking AeroTech from 188 of 272 to 221 - including M1340W and O5500X-PS, two of the four 98 mm motors previously reported as uncovered, and H13ST and H14ST. If you fly any DMS motor, re-open the design and re-fly it: the exit area adds thrust as the air thins, so the predicted apogee reads higher. Nothing already in the file moved - 49 rows added, none removed, no existing row changed. Every new row was read back off its own drawing and every exit was adversarially re-checked; none was refuted.
